name: Valverde de Alcalá (Spain)
description: Divided into two triangles, green with its base along the hoist and white with its base along the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valverde de Alcalá (a castle on green).
history: Municipal flag of Valverde de Alcalá; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
